a.lede: Anthropic's proposal requires evaluators to report any imminent risk to the Department of Commerce within 72 hours, after which the Department must present the evidence to a federal judge and await an order.
a.title: Anthropic’s proposed AI safety bill only kicks in if 50 deaths or $1 billion in damages are on the line

b.lede: The proposed policy seems to offer protections against AI run amok but actually forbids federal agencies from blocking a model's release without the permission of a judge.
b.title: Anthropic pitches AI safety bill that may block a model if 50+ people could be killed
